title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
summary: Learn the core ideas behind digital security, common threats, and safe online habits for students and professionals.
objectives: Recognize common web and system threats
Use safe digital habits in practical tasks
Build confidence before moving to technical labs

modules.title: What is cybersecurity?
modules.description: Understand why cybersecurity matters and what risks exist in online systems.

modules.title: Common attacks
modules.description: Explore phishing, malware, social engineering, and basic defense methods.

modules.title: Defense basics
modules.description: Learn how updates, backups, passwords, and access control protect users.

title: Ethical Hacking Basics
summary: Gain a structured understanding of ethical hacking, reconnaissance, and safe testing practices.
objectives: Learn how to document vulnerabilities responsibly
Apply defensive thinking to real-world scenarios

modules.title: Reconnaissance
modules.description: Learn how attackers and defenders gather information, ethically and legally.

modules.title: Vulnerability analysis
modules.description: Identify common weaknesses and understand their impact.

modules.title: Safe testing
modules.description: Use controlled environments and responsible disclosure strategies.
